name: asa
description: A batteries-included AdonisJS starter kit for building modern APIs with type-safe frontend integration

scripts.format: prettier --write AGENTS.md README.md CHANGELOG.md bump.config.ts changelog.config.ts .commitlintrc.json .github/workflows/ci.yml .vscode/*.json docs/*.md deploy/compose.yml deploy/docker-entrypoint.mjs && turbo format
scripts.format:check: prettier --check AGENTS.md README.md CHANGELOG.md bump.config.ts changelog.config.ts .commitlintrc.json .github/workflows/ci.yml .vscode/*.json docs/*.md deploy/compose.yml deploy/docker-entrypoint.mjs && turbo format:check
scripts.check: pnpm lint:check && pnpm format:check && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build

simple-git-hooks.pre-commit: pnpm lint:check && pnpm format:check && pnpm typecheck
